task.instruction: Search for a vegetarian lasagna recipe that has at least a four-star rating and over 500 reviews.

final_answer:
I found a great match on Allrecipes: **Artichoke Spinach Lasagna** (https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/20082/artichoke-spinach-lasagna/)

- **Rating:** 4.6 out of 5 stars (well above your four-star floor)
- **Reviews:** 1,287 written reviews from 1,824 ratings (far past the 500 minimum)
- **Why it qualifies as vegetarian:** an artichoke-and-spinach mixture cooked with vegetable broth, onions and garlic, layered with lasagna noodles, pasta sauce, mozzarella, and topped with crumbled feta — no meat.
- **Details:** Submitted by DMCCRACKEN, tested by the Allrecipes Test Kitchen, updated July 31, 2026. Prep 20 mins, cook 1 hr, total 1 hr 20 mins. 81 photos from home cooks.

For reference, two other vegetarian options on the same site also clear the bar but with fewer reviews: **Spinach Lasagna III** at 4.7 stars with 500 reviews, and **Simple Spinach Lasagna** at 565 ratings. The Artichoke Spinach Lasagna is the strongest pick of the three given its much larger review base.

judge.rationale: Final page shows Artichoke Spinach Lasagna with 4.6 rating, 1,287 reviews, and vegetarian ingredients/description from Allrecipes.

args.intent: Read the rating and review count shown on this recipe page so I can check it meets the four-star / 500-review bar.
